task.instruction: Find a Mexico hotel with deals for December 25-26.

final_answer:
I searched Booking.com for Mexico (the site resolved "Mexico" to Mexico City) for **Fri, Dec 25 → Sat, Dec 26, 2026 — 1 night, 2 adults, 1 room**, sorted lowest price first. Here are the standout deals, all with real markdowns or unusually good value for the dates:

**Biggest discounts**
- **Rooms Zocalo** — Historic Center, 350 m from downtown · 6.4/10 (1,328 reviews) · Standard Double, shared bath · **US$25 → US$14** (+~US$3 taxes). Cheapest discounted room in the center.
- **Hotel Plaza San Juan** — Iztacalco, 7.7 km out · 8.2/10 (614 reviews) · Queen Room · **US$34 → US$20** (+~US$4) · free cancellation, no prepayment.
- **Hotel & Villas 7** — Iztacalco, 8.6 km out · 7.8/10 (3,180 reviews) · Deluxe Suite, king bed · **US$22 → US$17** (+~US$3) · free cancellation, pay at property.
- **Alameda House** — Historic Center, 1.2 km · 5.5/10 (2,831 reviews) · Double, shared bath · **US$19 → US$16** · free cancellation, no prepayment.
- **Hostal T M** — Historic Center, 450 m · "Late Escape Deal" · 2 dorm beds · **US$26 → US$16**.

**Best value without needing a discount**
- **Hotel H – Eco Adults Only** — Buenavista, 2.1 km · 7.3/10 (393 reviews) · Deluxe Double, king bed · **US$15 all-in, zero taxes**, free cancellation, pay at property. Best absolute price for a private room.
- **Hotel Dos Naciones** — Guerrero, 1.1 km · 8.0/10 (800 reviews) · King Room · **US$23 including taxes** · free cancellation.
- **Hostal del angel** — Colonia Cuauhtémoc/Reforma, 3.9 km · 8.6/10 (57 reviews) · dorm bed · **US$20**.

**If you'd rather trade price for quality:** *La Casa Azul (Zona de Hospitales)* is 9.0/10 with 475 reviews at **US$67** (free cancellation), and *One Ciudad de México Periférico* is 8.5/10 with 1,392 reviews at **US$70** with breakfast included and free cancellation.

My pick for a genuine deal: **Hotel Plaza San Juan** (8.2/10, 41% off at US$20, free cancellation) if you don't mind being 7.7 km from the center, or **Hotel H – Eco Adults Only** at US$15 all-in if you want the cheapest private room near downtown. Note that the deepest discounts cluster in the budget/hostel tier — the 8.5+ rated hotels are holding steady around US$67–70 for these dates.

judge.rationale: The final page shows Booking.com results for Mexico City, Dec 25–26, with discounted hotels like Rooms Zocalo US$25→US$14 and Hotel Plaza San Juan US$34→US$20.
